hero: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished background illustration for a 16:9 Unity PC game main menu. Primary request: Mediterranean Antalya environmental food inspection station overlooking the old harbour, for a COP31-themed first-person food inspection game. Scene: a small sunlit coastal inspection office with a wooden workbench, a paper fax, a few local dairy packages and citrus crates in the right foreground; turquoise Mediterranean water, Antalya old harbour architecture and distant Taurus mountains seen beyond. A small caretta caretta sea turtle is visible naturally in the clear shallow water on the right. Style: polished stylized 3D game key art, tactile painted textures, warm late-afternoon light, restrained detail, inviting but grounded. Composition: wide 16:9 panorama; keep the left 40 percent quiet, dark desaturated teal and low-detail for a left-side UI menu; place the main scenic focus in the right two thirds, with safe crop margins. Palette: deep teal, warm linen, muted terracotta, Mediterranean turquoise, subtle amber sunlight. Constraints: background artwork only, no interface, no buttons, no lettering, no logos, no seals, no watermark, no people. High-quality landscape image suitable for a full-screen background.
